checkedAlternates.risk: Both submissions and takedowns are grappling moves.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An armbar is a ground joint-lock submission (group-1), whereas throws and takedowns bring a standing opponent down (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Clinching can lead to trips or takedowns.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A knee strike is a percussive lower-limb strike (group-3), not a throw or takedown (group-2).
